LanguageData.Geigercounter1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study radiation detector designs to learn how they work.
LanguageData.Geigercounter2.description: A skilled crafter needs to figure out how to build and maintain radiation detectors for all colonists.
LanguageData.RadiationSuits1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study protective apparel designs to learn how they work before we can start making our own.
LanguageData.RadiationSuits2.description: A skilled crafter needs to draw up plans for tailoring radiation suits.
LanguageData.NuclearResearch1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study research reactor designs to learn how they work before we can build our own.
LanguageData.NuclearResearchPractical.description: A skilled researcher needs to install reactor control software and perform training exercises while testing the reactor's capabilities.
LanguageData.NuclearReactorResearchPhase.description: A skilled researcher needs to study Rimatomics reactor designs and prepare for the construction of our first nuclear reactor.
LanguageData.NuclearReactorExperiments.label: Experiment with research reactors
LanguageData.NuclearReactorExperiments.description: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with a research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
LanguageData.BuildReactorCore.description: Build the frame for a nuclear reactor core. Once the frame is complete, more work must be done to finish construction.
LanguageData.TestReactor.description: Construct or purchase nuclear fuel rods and load them into the reactor core. Use an attached reactor console to designate slots for loading. Load at least two fuel rods side-by-side to create a chain, use the reactor console to start the core, and then raise the control rods to 8% or higher to start gathering data.
LanguageData.Plutonium1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study the plutonium processing pipeline and finalize designs for a prototype fuel reprocessing facility.
LanguageData.Plutonium2.description: Construct a plutonium processor. To reduce the duration of exposure while handling radioactive fuel, it is advised that the plutonium processor be located only a short distance away from reactors or spent fuel storage.
LanguageData.Plutonium3.label: Experiment with the plutonium processor
LanguageData.Plutonium3.description: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with the prototype plutonium processor to ensure that it is functioning correctly. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
LanguageData.AdvReactor1.label: Experiment with research reactors
LanguageData.AdvReactor1.description: A skilled researcher needs to experiment with a research reactor. This step has a chance for catastrophic failures!
LanguageData.AdvReactor2.description: A skilled researcher needs to finalize the designs for advanced reactors before they are ready for construction.
LanguageData.AdvReactor3.description: Build the frame for an advanced reactor core. Once the frame is complete, more work must be done to finish construction.
LanguageData.AdvReactor4.description: Power up the reactor and start producing power to gather data.
LanguageData.RTG1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study RTG designs to learn how they work before we can start making our own.
LanguageData.RTG3.description: A skilled crafter needs to plan how to make the components required for RTGs.
LanguageData.ICBM1.description: A skilled researcher needs to study nuclear weapons designs and learn how they work before we can start making our own.
LanguageData.ICBM3.description: Experiment with a research reactor to gain a greater understanding of nuclear physics before we attempt to build a weapon.
LanguageData.ICBM4.label: Construct a Semi-Automated Command Station (SACS)
LanguageData.ICBM4.description: Build a SACS to initiate missile launches.
LanguageData.ICBM5.description: Build a TACS to assist with missile navigation.
LanguageData.ICBM6.description: Construct a Liberator. It must be connected to the same power grid as a SACS.
LanguageData.ICBM7.description: Launch a strategic missile at any target to gather data.
